messages:
Nadia: Late PM handover — quick FYI, prefetch error-rate has been noisy on and off since ~20:10 UTC. Not a full incident but worth watching tonight. Key things below.

oncall-bot: [ALERT] prefetch_error_rate > 0.8 for 5m (eu-west1) — severity: low — fired at 2026-03-17T20:12:03Z

Jon: Saw the spike on grafana, p95 latency for prefetch up to 420ms during the window. Link: https://grafana.redwood/boards/prefetch (check panel: prefetch.errors). :eyes:

Priya: I muted the low-priority noise alert for 15m (rule: prefetch_noise_low) to avoid pager churn while we investigate. Left a note in the runbook. :white_check_mark:

Nadia: Thx. Quick checklist for whoever covers: 1) check grafana panel for correlated encoder restarts, 2) tail prefetch logs, 3) check redis-proxy pod restarts, 4) watch traffic routing (canary).

Jon: Quick log command I used: `kubectl -n inference logs deploy/prefetch --since=10m | grep -i "prefetch-error" -A3 -B1` — saw a few `connection reset by peer` lines.

Marco: I ran that too. Redis-proxy had a restart at 20:05 (node eu-west1-b). Looks like a flurry of TCP resets right after. Not seeing GC spikes on prefetch pods.

Priya: There's an open PR (#3456) that adds jittered backoff to prefetch retries — would probably reduce bursty error amplification. Assigning to Jon for review if you have time tonight.

Jon: Will pick up the PR in the next hour. If we see error-rate > 2% for 10m, escalate to @infra-oncall and open a pager per runbook.

Nadia: I've archived logs to s3://redwood-ops/prefetch/2026-03-17/ and left a short note in the shift doc. If you step in during my shift, DM me for context. :hand:

Marco: Minor note — metric noise seems concentrated on longer tails (seq len > 1024) in the canary traffic. If you can, toggle canary -> 0.5 for 10m to see effect.

Priya: FYI also added a temporary dashboard panel that overlays redis-proxy restarts with prefetch errors. Will revert after midnight.

Jon: Thanks all — I'll keep an eye until 23:00 UTC and post any escalations here. :thumbsup:
thread_summary: Late PM non-incident handover: prefetch error-rate noisy, muted low-priority alert for 15m, checklist (grafana, logs, redis-proxy, canary), found redis-proxy restarts, PR #3456 for backoff assigned to Jon, escalation threshold defined, logs archived, temporary dashboard added.
